column1: # retro-overrides.tsv — retro values that differ from the commit-day calc on purpose.
# The calc (snap_fib(commit_days(n)), see retro-lib.sh) measures distinct days with a
# commit claiming the issue. That under-counts work that was thought through over days
# but committed in one sitting, and it cannot see days a ticket sat while other work took
# priority. Where the recorded number came from judgment instead, record it here and the
# audit reports OVERRIDE rather than DRIFT.
# The VALUE is part of the acknowledgement, not just the issue number: if the board later
# holds a different retro, it drifts again and wants a fresh look. Deliberately narrow —
# this silences one reviewed number, never an issue forever.
# Tab-separated: issue<TAB>acknowledged retro<TAB>reason. Added by issue #282.
# Seeded 2026-09-12 from the 13 DRIFT rows then on the 2.0 board; sharpen a reason when
